name: inspira-meteors
blurb: Falling meteors with glowing trails animated across the screen.
description: CSS-animated meteor shower with randomized delay and duration per meteor. Each meteor is a small glowing dot with a trailing gradient that falls diagonally down the screen.
use_when: A dramatic, animated background effect for hero sections or dark-themed pages.
avoid_when: Performance-sensitive contexts where many simultaneous animations impact responsiveness.
a11y: Purely decorative animated elements; focus and keyboard behaviour come from overlaid content. Animation has no prefers-reduced-motion guard.
